title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
  • Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to

As set forth in Carta’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead Backend Developer (.Net) , you’ll drive the transition from ArcGIS to a modern, open-source geospatial stack, shaping a platform that empowers environmental and agricultural insights. This 3‑month project offers full ownership of backend architecture and the chance to solve complex, high‑impact challenges with geospatial data services, cloud infrastructure, and scalable APIs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Work on a 3‑month project .
  • Design, build, and maintain robust geospatial APIs (REST, OGC standards) including features like BBOX/filter queries, authentication, pagination, and health/metrics.
  • Process and publish Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) .
  • Work with spatial databases such as SQL Server Spatial or PostGIS, including performance tuning (spatial indexes, SRIDs, tiling strategies).
  • Deploy and provision cloud infrastructure, specifically on Azure.
  • Collaborate on transitioning away from ArcGIS to achieve greater independence and enhanced system control.

MUST HAVES

  • 6+ years of experience with .NET .
  • Hands‑on experience with geospatial data services and tooling, specifically TiTiler and/or GeoServer for dynamic tile serving.
  • Proficiency in spatial databases such as SQL Server Spatial or PostGIS , including performance tuning.
  • Experience designing and maintaining geospatial APIs .
  • Strong experience with cloud deployment and provisioning on Azure .
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) on Azure.
  • Experience migrating services away from an Esri/ArcGIS stack (ImageServer, FeatureServer).
  • Knowledge of open‑source basemap providers like OpenMapTiles or Planet OSM.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Quality Automation Engineer – Digital Health
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work‑life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer to join our rapidly growing telemedicine platform and help maintain the highest standards of product quality across our digital healthcare solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that support both web and mobile applications. You will play a key part in driving our automation strategy, integrating tests within our CI/CD pipeline, and collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams to deliver high‑quality releases.

This is a hands‑on role that requires both technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll work alongside developers, product managers, and DevOps to identify quality risks early, resolve issues efficiently, and continuously improve our QA processes. The ideal candidate is someone who takes initiative, communicates clearly, and thrives in a fast‑paced, fully remote environment. If you are passionate about automation, healthcare innovation, and making an impact through quality engineering, this is an excellent opportunity to join a mission‑driven team.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust test automation frameworks.
  • Write, execute, and maintain automated tests for web, mobile, and API applications.
  • Collaborate with developers and product managers to create comprehensive test plans.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing and fast releases.
  • Conduct performance and load testing to ensure system reliability.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, collaborating with development teams to resolve them.
  • Generate reports on test coverage, automation progress, and product quality metrics.
  • Continuously improve QA tools, methodologies, and documentation processes.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as PHP, JavaScript, or C#.
  • Hands‑on experience with tools like Playwright (preferred), Robot, Selenium, or Postman.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to write automated API tests.

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office
  • Flexible Hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company
  • International Projects
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational)
  • Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass
  • Games and Competitions

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI`s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recuperar os danificados, registrar na ficha pessoal do colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;
  • Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

The position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Your profile

Your profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.

  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.

  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Location: Brazil

About The Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose‑led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income, and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

Responsibilities

  • Support members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement process, training and events.
  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team and support reporting for the region.

Membership Engagement & Support

  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and elevate when needed.
  • Support external communications and raise awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.

Supply Chain Operations

  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in‑person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.

Reporting & Administration

  • Provide high‑quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.

Essential

  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – advanced Excel functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for online and in‑person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, adaptability, problem‑solving, attention to detail, and time management.

Desirable

  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Power BI or similar tool.
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability.
  • Cultural sensitivity.
  • Initiative and ownership.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary.
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements.
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year.
  • Continuous learning and development.
  • Life insurance, dental insurance, medical insurance, meal voucher allowance.
  • 13th salary (bonus) – paid in 2 installments Nov/Dev.
  • Legal protections of local labour law and all other Better Cotton Global Policies apply.
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8–9 bank holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued.
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.

Working Arrangements

The position is full‑time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply Now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1 page maximum) by or before via this link. In your cover letter, please explain why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Our Hiring Process

Initial Screening

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management.

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not‑for‑profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments, and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand.

About Our Values

  • Trustworthy (honest, transparent, credible).
  • Integrity (responsible, authentic).
  • Positive (problem‑solving, pragmatic).
  • Engaging (adaptable, inclusive, holistic).
  • Daring (courageous, innovative, game‑changing).

Being you @ Better Cotton

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources. We have a zero‑tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

O profissional será responsável por conduzir análises pós-EVTE (Estudo de Viabilidade Técnico-Econômica) dos contratos vigentes, comparando o desempenho real com as premissas originais e propondo planos de ação para otimizar resultados. Além disso, deverá identificar novas oportunidades comerciais em serviços, tanto a partir do portfólio existente quanto de benchmarks e tendências de mercado, em colaboração com áreas como Comercial, Engenharia, Operações, Pricing, Inovação e Energia.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar pós-EVTE de contratos vigentes, avaliando resultados financeiros, operacionais e comerciais versus as expectativas originais;
  • Identificar gaps de performance e oportunidades de aumento de rentabilidade por cliente, região e segmento;
  • Construir e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) que sustentem decisões estratégicas de portfólio e priorização de investimentos;
  • Mapear oportunidades de expansão de serviços e soluções B2B, com base em análise de mercado, benchmarking e retorno financeiro esperado;
  • Apoiar o time comercial na formatação de propostas de valor e business cases, contribuindo para fidelização e crescimento da base de clientes;
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento e teste de novos modelos de negócio junto às áreas de Inovação e Engenharia;
  • Conduzir a implantação de projetos de novos negócios, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, escopo e metas financeiras;
  • Garantir alinhamento entre as áreas envolvidas, promovendo integração e visão de portfólio;
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e apresentações de resultado, consolidando os aprendizados e impactos obtidos.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlativas;
  • Experiência sólida em análise de viabilidade econômica, rentabilidade de contratos e gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em métodos de desenvolvimento de negócios e inovação (Design Thinking, Lean Startup);
  • Desejável vivência com clientes B2B e atuação em empresas dos setores energia, infraestrutura ou serviços industriais;
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Certificações como PMP, Agile ou afins serão diferenciais;
  • Competências Comportamentais;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico;
  • Visão de dono, proatividade e senso de urgência;
  • Habilidade em influenciar e articular soluções entre diferentes áreas;

  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap (an) ate anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia.

  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado.
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar‑se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequado.

  18. Usar adequadamente os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de material utilizado e norma regulamentadora NR32.
  19. Preencher diariamente no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia, repondo os materiais faltantes.
  20. Estar ciente quanto aos procedimentos que serão realizados na sala de hemodinâmica sob sua responsabilidade.

  • Provide technical guidance and share best practices with lower-level mechanics, supporting the development of less experienced team members.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned, within the scope of the position and the company’s operational needs.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

Sales Enablement : Responsável pelo desenvolvimento contínuo do time, com foco em capacitação, produção de conteúdos, construção de playbooks, definição de ritos e garantia da qualidade nas interações entre agentes e clientes.

Eficiência Comercial : Atua na otimização dos processos de vendas, revisando etapas do funil, identificando gargalos (sejam eles de processo ou tecnologia) e apoiando a construção de fluxos estruturados que aumentem a conversão e proporcionem uma melhor experiência ao cliente.

  • Estruturar e atualizar materiais (roteiros, playbooks, apresentações) alinhados às melhorias identificadas.

Residir no RJ ou ter mobilidade para o Rio de Janeiro.

Familiaridade com IA e automação (Gemini, OpenAI, Notebook LM) para escalar análises e monitorias.

Experiência em gestão de projetos e metodologias ágeis (Trello/Jira).

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento do Programa BIS (Programa de Melhoria e Inovação da Empresa);
  • Desenvolver apresentações gerenciais;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de ferramentas de gestão;
  • Apoiar nas atividades de mapear e avaliar oportunidades de melhorias operacionais e Corporativas;
  • Tornar as equipes autônomas a longo prazo no que diz respeito ao gerenciamento dos seus indicadores e garantindo sua aceitação e busca contínua por melhorias.
  • Fomento a cultura de Inovação e Excelência;

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de agentes de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Desenvolvimento de ferramentas e rotinas para controle de atividades diversas.

Qualificações

  • Estudante de Engenharia ou Administração. (Faltando de 1 ano para formar)

Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma empresa de exploração, desenvolvimento e operação de ativos minerais no Brasil.

Com 18 anos de experiência, atualmente estamos presentes em todas as regiões do país, com um portfólio diversificado que engloba uma ampla gama de minerais, tais como minério de ferro, ouro, níquel, terras raras, fosfato e calcário.

Possuímos projetos em diferentes etapas da atividade mineral, desde a etapa greenfield até a operação, e contamos com mais de 2100 colaboradores por todo o Brasil engajados em nosso propósito.

Atualmente, contamos com três operações de Minério de Ferro em Minas Gerais: as Minas Baratinha e Mongais, pertencentes ao Complexo Baratinha e a Mina Pedra Branca.

Nossa primeira operação de minério de ferro, a Mina Baratinha, no Vale do Aço, iniciou atividades em 2014 e possui planta de beneficiamento úmido com capacidade de 2,5 milhões de toneladas ao ano. Em 2024, entrou em operação o projeto Mongais, com capacidade de produção a seco de 1,5 milhões de tonelada ao ano, ampliando a capacidade total do Complexo Baratinha para 4,0 milhões de tonelada ao ano.

Já nos municípios de João Monlevade e Itabira (MG), iniciamos a operação do projeto Pedra Branca no terceiro trimestre de 2025. O projeto conta com recursos de 130 milhões de toneladas, sendo 33 milhões de toneladas de alto teor e sua produção deverá atingir 2,0 milhões de toneladas ao ano em plena capacidade, apenas com processamento a seco.

Além disso, a Bemisa possui uma operação de ouro em escala piloto no estado do Pará, em Água Azul do Norte, próxima ao distrito polimetálico de Carajás. Desenvolvido desde o estágio greenfield, o projeto não utiliza barragem para a disposição de rejeitos e emprega majoritariamente trabalhadores locais.

Acreditamos no potencial da mineração do Brasil e temos como compromisso a integração da sustentabilidade em nossas operações, gerando desenvolvimento socioeconômico em todas as regiões em que atuamos.

Descrição de cargo:

  • Contribuir tecnicamente para etapa de Viabilidade de novos projetos;
  • Desenvolver novos produtos, formulações e processos de fabricação promovendo o aumento do portfólio da empresa, conforme políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos na companhia.
  • Documentar todas as etapas de desenvolvimento de um novo produto de forma que as informações necessárias estejam presentes em documentos padronizados e oficiais;
  • Iniciar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto com um processo racional e padrão de desenvolvimento, baseado em ciência e investigação, visando sempre a qualidade no processo de desenvolvimento para mitigar problemas na rotina futura, usando conceitos de “Quality by Design” e “DoE” e “PAT”;

  • Realizar estudos prévios de pré-formulação de IFAs (insumo farmacêutico ativo), excipientes, fórmulas e processos através de pesquisas bibliográficas, estudos de artigos e estudos de patentes;
  • Pesquisar, identificar, registrar e monitorar parâmetros e pontos críticos do processo e do produto, descrevendo nos relatórios de desenvolvimento todo o racional desde o início das etapas de desenvolvimento;
  • Testar diferentes ranges do processo durante a etapa de desenvolvimento, avaliando o impacto nos atributos de qualidade de produto. Monitorá-los nas etapas de validação e transferência;
  • Avaliar com criticidade os resultados analíticos obtidos em cada teste realizado e propor melhorias eficientes para melhor desempenho da formulação. Realizar o recebimento, pesagem e separação de matérias-primas e material de embalagem;

  • Elaborar a documentação técnica para submissão de novos registros em parceria com o departamento Regulatório e Desenvolvimento Analítico, visando atender os requisitos da legislação vigente.
  • Disponibilizar todas as informações técnicas necessárias para lançamento de um novo produto, tais como: estruturas de produto, procedimentos de fabricação e embalagem, forma de acondicionamento, especificações das matérias primas, granéis, intermediários e produto acabado, prazo de validade, bem como os parâmetros críticos de processo, os atributos de qualidade e os perfis alvo de cada produto;

  • Garantir a padronização das atividades relacionadas ao setor, através da elaboração e/ou revisão dos Procedimentos Operacionais (OP).
  • Garantir que a área Galênica esteja sempre de acordo com as normas do Sistema da Qualidade e EHS.
  • Garantir o tratamento das ações do sistema da qualidade provenientes de Auditorias e monitoramentos realizados pelo time de Quality Assurance.
  • Conhecer os riscos potenciais presentes nas novas atividades, antes do trabalho iniciar.
  • Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial da empresa.
  • Ser organizado, proativo e apresentar senso de propriedade na condução de projetos e nas atividades designadas pela coordenação/gerência da área.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Formação universitária em: Superior completo em Farmácia,
  • Desejável Especialização, Mestrado ou doutorado na área de Desenvolvimento de Formulação e Processos Farmacêuticos.

Qualificações preferenciais

title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, gaiolas, etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.

description: Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor de Integração que irá atuar como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de DevSecOps para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados. Seus desafios serão: Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração. Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório. Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados. Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback. Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos. Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc. Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência. Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais. O que é necessário você ter: Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI. Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas. Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.). Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices. Experiência com integração segura ( JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls). Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift). Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.). Automação de testes e validações em integrações. Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.). Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise). Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.). Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

title: Gerente Operacional
description:
A Acoem Ambiental, anteriormente JCTM, é referência nacional no fornecimento de soluções completas para monitoramento ambiental nas áreas de qualidade do ar, ruído, vibração, emissões, hidrologia e meteorologia. Este é um momento estratégico de integração, expansão e fortalecimento da operação no Brasil, com foco em eficiência, crescimento sustentável e alinhamento aos padrões globais do grupo. Resumo da posição O Gerente Operacional será responsável pela gestão integral da unidade de Belford Roxo, assegurando a excelência operacional, o cumprimento de metas financeiras e o alinhamento estratégico com os objetivos da Acoem Brasil e do Grupo Acoem. Com perfil estratégico e hands-on, este(a) profissional liderará equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo produtividade, qualidade e alto nível de serviço ao cliente. Reportará diretamente ao Diretor Executivo da Acoem Brasil, desempenhando papel-chave no crescimento, rentabilidade e sustentabilidade da operação. Principais responsabilidades Gestão estratégica e execução operacional Definir e implementar a estratégia operacional da unidade, alinhada à visão e aos objetivos da Acoem Brasil. Garantir o cumprimento de prazos (OTD – On Time Delivery), padrões de qualidade e metas financeiras. Supervisionar e integrar as áreas de Produção, Logística, Estoque, Compras, Administrativo e Financeiro, otimizando fluxos de trabalho e recursos. Performance financeira e orçamentária Elaborar e gerenciar o orçamento anual, assegurando controle rigoroso de custos e maximização da rentabilidade. Monitorar indicadores financeiros e operacionais, implementando ações corretivas e de melhoria contínua. Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos sem comprometer qualidade e prazos. Qualidade, compliance e melhoria contínua Garantir conformidade com todas as normas legais, regulatórias e padrões de qualidade aplicáveis ao setor ambiental. Implantar e manter sistemas robustos de gestão da qualidade. Promover cultura de melhoria contínua e inovação em processos e serviços. Liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes Inspirar, desenvolver e reter talentos, promovendo engajamento e alta performance. Fomentar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com autonomia, responsabilidade e foco em resultados. Garantir que as equipes estejam capacitadas nas tecnologias e padrões do Grupo Acoem. Relacionamento com clientes e mercado Atuar como representante estratégico junto a clientes, parceiros e órgãos reguladores. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada em posição de liderança operacional em empresas de bens de capital, serviços técnicos ou monitoramento ambiental. Formação superior em Engenharia (Ambiental, Mecânica, Elétrica, Civil ou áreas afins);
desejável pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão, Operações ou áreas correlatas. Inglês avançado para comunicação com matriz e parceiros internacionais. Forte domínio em gestão financeira, análise de rentabilidade, orçamento e controle de custos. Habilidade para liderar equipes multidisciplinares e conduzir mudanças organizacionais. Facilidade de acesso a Belford Roxo – RJ. Diferenciais Experiência com tecnologias de monitoramento ambiental (ar, ruído, vibração, emissões) e/ou confiabilidade industrial. Vivência em integração pós-aquisição ou transformação organizacional. Atuação prévia em licitações governamentais e relacionamento com órgãos ambientais. Espanhol intermediário ou avançado

title: Supervisor De Tax Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas. Atuamos com foco em inteligência fiscal, identificando oportunidades de economia, mitigações de riscos e garantindo o compliance com a legislação. É uma área dinâmica, que combina análise técnica, visão de negócio e proximidade com o cliente — ideal para quem gosta de desafios, atualização constante e impacto direto nos resultados das organizações. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias. Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico. Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas. Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas. Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível. Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo. Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos. Participar de propostas comerciais, reuniões com clientes e contribuir para o fortalecimento da área de TAX Indiretos. Requisitos: Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em apuração, revisão e planejamento de tributos indiretos. Domínio das legislações de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, e dos regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional. Vivência em revisão de compliance fiscal, levantamento de créditos tributários e regimes especiais é um diferencial. Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado. Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para lidar com diferentes interlocutores. Inglês intermediário ou avançado é desejável. Competências comportamentais: Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico. Boa comunicação oral e escrita. Proatividade e perfil hands-on. Liderança e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe. Organização e foco em resultados. Benefícios Convênio com o SESC;
